subject: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Taney <susan.taney@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount

Hi Susan — great talking earlier. Quick recap and a few questions so we can align procurement with finance on your side: 

1) PO & invoice fields: you mentioned Maple requires a PO number on line-item level and an internal project code in the invoice memo. Can you attach the exact PO template you want us to use? If you have any mandatory XML schema or header keys (e.g., your ERP requires PO_REF, BU_CODE, TAXID), please send those.

2) Invoice cadence / splits: you said Finance prefers monthly invoices but may accept quarterly consolidations for larger commitments. For pricing/discounting we need to confirm whether they will pay Net30 or Net60 — that materially affects our ability to offer a prepay/discount structure.

3) Discount trigger: you asked about a 12% on-commit discount if Maple issues a 6-month upfront purchase order for a minimum committed spend. We can model that but need confirmation on the PO/advance mechanics and refund/true-up language.

I've attached a proposed pricing workbook and a draft SOW so procurement can see line items vs invoice rows. If you can send the Maple PO template, I'll circulate internally and get back with a clean PO-ready invoice sample.

Next step: if possible, can procurement share the PO template (or a redacted example) by end of week? I'll follow up with Grace on discount structuring.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Proposed_PRICING_2026.xlsx, Redwood_DRAFT_SOW.pdf
From: Susan Taney <susan.taney@maplehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T13:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the summary. Attaching our standard PO template (Maple_PO_Template.xlsx) — procurement requires PO number at the line level and a field called PROJECT_CODE that ties invoices back to the contracting BU. A couple clarifications from Finance / Procurement: 

- Our standard term is Net60 for new vendors above $250k annually; Net30 only when prepay/advance is provided.
- For multi-entity invoices, we prefer separate invoice files per legal entity (two ERPs in play). Consolidated invoices are allowed but need a per-entity breakdown.
- Any conditional discount tied to an advance PO needs a clause for crediting/true-up if utilization is below committed consumption within a 90-day period.

We can accept a 6-month PO for a committed minimum spend, but we require the PO to include a cancel-for-convenience threshold and a sample refund schedule in the contract. Procurement also requested a tax ID and our vendor onboarding team will need an initial W-9.

Looping in Markus Hale from Procurement on next steps — Markus, can you confirm whether finance will accept a staged invoice cadence (monthly invoices with mid-quarter reconciliations) for pricing that assumes an upfront credit?

Best,
Susan
Head of Procurement, Maple Health
susan.taney@maplehealth.com

Attachment: Maple_PO_Template.xlsx
From: Markus Hale <markus.hale@maplehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Susan Taney <susan.taney@maplehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T08:25:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount

Ben / Susan — quick note from Finance: Net60 is the baseline, but they will agree to Net30 if Maple issues a 6-month prepay PO and Redwood provides an upfront credit schedule that is non-refundable for used consumption and refundable proportional to unused committed units after 90 days. For multi-entity flows: we cannot mix entities on a single invoice PDF; please provide separate invoice files or CSVs mapped to entity TAXIDs.

Also, procurement prefers that the invoice filename include: PO_<PO_NUMBER>_<ENTITY>_<YYYYMM>.pdf so AP can automate ingestion. If Redwood can produce that naming convention automatically from invoice generation, it would speed onboarding.

Regards,
Markus Hale
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Maple Health
markus.hale@maplehealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Taney <susan.taney@maplehealth.com>, Markus Hale <markus.hale@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount

Thanks Markus — that's clear and doable on our side. Quick updates: 

- We can support the filename convention (PO_<PO_NUMBER>_<ENTITY>_<YYYYMM>.pdf) from our billing pipeline.
- We will generate separate invoice PDFs per legal entity and include a CSV export for accounting reconciliation.
- On the discount: Redwood can offer a 12% committed-spend discount if Maple issues a 6-month PO covering a minimum committed spend of $240,000 and remits an upfront credit equal to 50% of the first two months' fees. The remaining credit is applied monthly as consumption occurs; any unused credit after 90 days from contract start will be refunded pro rata per entity.

I need internal sign-off on the specific refund wording (legal) and whether we can accept the cancel-for-convenience threshold you mentioned. Looping in Grace and Vanessa for pricing/legal clearance.

Ben
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T14:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount (internal)

Ben — thanks for the note. Quick internal decisions: 

- Pricing: we can approve the 12% discount tied to the 6-month PO with $240k minimum. Finance wants the upfront credit as an account-level prepayment, not a separate escrow. Acceptable.
- Legal / Refund language: Legal will draft a clause where unused credits are refundable pro rata after 90 days, subject to a 30-day notice and reconciliation. However, we should push back on a wide cancel-for-convenience threshold — limit cancellation to volume-based reductions (e.g., >50% drop in consumption) to avoid gaming.
- Invoicing: Engineering/Finance team will add the filename template into our billing export and produce a sample set of invoices for Maple's AP (example files attached).

Action items for Ben: produce a proposed PO-ready invoice sample (two files for two entities) using PO_8892_ENTITYA_20260901.pdf naming convention, and share the vendor onboarding packet (W-9 + tax ID). Grace will coordinate legal language and Vanessa will prepare an implementation timeline for billing pipeline changes.

Thanks,
Grace
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: proposed invoice samples (will follow via secure link)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Taney <susan.taney@maplehealth.com>, Markus Hale <markus.hale@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Maple Health — PO format requirements, invoice cadence & conditional discount

Susan / Markus — thanks. I'll deliver the two sample invoices and the vendor onboarding packet by EOD Monday (W-9, Redwood tax ID, and a sample invoice CSV). Attached are the pricing workbook and draft SOW for your review (Redwood_Proposed_PRICING_2026.xlsx, Redwood_DRAFT_SOW.pdf).

Summary of agreed items so far: 
- Filename & per-entity invoice PDFs: Redwood will produce PO-numbered PDFs and a reconciliation CSV.
- Net terms: Maple baseline Net60; Net30 if 6-month prepay PO accepted.
- Discount: 12% off list if Maple issues a 6-month PO >= $240k and remits 50% upfront credit; remaining credit applied against consumption; refunds pro rata after 90 days per legal clause.
- PO must include PROJECT_CODE per Maple template; Redwood will map that into invoice memo.

Next steps: I will upload the sample invoices to the procurement link and send a DocuSign for the SOW + refund clause once legal confirms wording. 

Ben
Senior Account Executive

Related links: DocuSign draft (will follow), HubSpot deal MAP-2026-0892
